title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
summary: OpenAI于11月3日公布Astra和Codex参与机械、电气及系统工程的试验，两名成员用不足一周设计出可与Codex对话的设备，代工厂随后制成小批原型。公司同时承认制造公差、装配细节和工厂限制仍须多轮人工审查。
investorNote: 工程设计的真正门槛在制造可行性与跨学科约束，原型速度不能直接等同于量产能力。

fact.subject: OpenAI
fact.action: 公布工程设计与制造工作流测试
fact.object: Astra、Codex在机械和电气设计中的应用

evidence.quote: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products.
Getting the device ready for manufacturing still required several rounds of review and iteration.
A newer internal model achieved an average score of 0.875, compared with 0.594 for GPT‑6 Astra at its highest reasoning setting.
Two team members designed this test device with Astra in under a week while working on it as a side project. A contract manufacturer built a small batch of prototypes in under a month.

displayTitle: OpenAI展示Astra参与硬件设计：原型已造出，量产约束仍需人工审查
narrative: OpenAI展示了Astra辅助完成外壳、PCB与软件集成的硬件原型，并公开制造环节仍需人工复核的限制。内部BenchCAD 2.0成绩提升说明能力在进步，但这是公司自测，不能外推成端到端无人制造。
